ITEM 1 | Large heap of white, soft, crumbly-to-flaky curds with irregular ragged edges and a matte, slightly moist surface, spread across the left half of the plate, roughly 12 cm by 11 cm and about 3 cm tall, with small yellowish pockets and some pale wet sheen | 230
ITEM 2 | Cubed pieces, roughly 2 cm each, with golden-brown crisp edges and pale tan interiors, some with darker browned and slightly glossy patches, clustered on the right side of the plate in a layer about 1.5 to 2 cm thick, sitting next to the curds | 170
ITEM 3 | Diced watermelon-like pink-red pieces, about 2 to 2.5 cm cubes with cut faces, moist and slightly glossy, grouped in the lower right corner beside the grapes, roughly 6 cm by 5 cm footprint and about 1.5 cm tall | 95
ITEM 4 | Whole round dark red grapes, about 1.5 to 2 cm diameter, smooth glossy skins, scattered in a loose cluster along the lower right edge of the plate beside the potato cubes and melon | 80
